question: Which goods break first when a crisis hits Luxembourg's exports, and which import is critical?
title: Luxembourg Trade Crisis Impact on Goods
approach: This chain identifies which export goods break first during crises by analyzing the largest export declines in crisis years and determines the critical import by ranking imports with the largest declines in the same periods. It compares key crisis years with their preceding years to pinpoint vulnerable goods.

steps.question: Which export goods had the largest declines in value between 2008 and 2009 during the financial crisis in Luxembourg?
steps.purpose: To identify which export goods broke first during the 2008 financial crisis by showing the largest export value declines between 2008 and 2009.
steps.queried: exports · by HS2 product (top 10) · 2008–2009 · change between the two years

steps.question: Which export goods had the largest declines in value between 2019 and 2020 during the COVID-19 crisis in Luxembourg?
steps.purpose: To identify which export goods broke first during the 2019-2020 COVID-19 crisis by showing the largest export value declines between 2019 and 2020.
steps.queried: exports · by HS2 product (top 10) · 2019–2020 · change between the two years

steps.question: Which import goods had the largest declines in value between 2008 and 2009 during the financial crisis in Luxembourg?
steps.purpose: To identify critical imports affected during the 2008 financial crisis by showing the largest import value declines between 2008 and 2009.
steps.queried: imports · by HS2 product (top 10) · 2008–2009 · change between the two years

steps.question: Which import goods had the largest declines in value between 2019 and 2020 during the COVID-19 crisis in Luxembourg?
steps.purpose: To identify critical imports affected during the 2019-2020 COVID-19 crisis by showing the largest import value declines between 2019 and 2020.
steps.queried: imports · by HS2 product (top 10) · 2019–2020 · change between the two years

steps.question: Which export goods had the largest declines in value between 2007 and 2008 during the financial crisis in Luxembourg?
steps.purpose: Steps 1 and 2 show which export goods broke first during the 2008-2009 and 2019-2020 crises, but to understand the onset of the 2008 crisis it is useful to see the export declines immediately before 2008.
steps.queried: exports · by HS2 product (top 10) · 2007–2008 · change between the two years

steps.question: Which import goods had the largest declines in value between 2018 and 2019 during the COVID-19 crisis in Luxembourg?
steps.purpose: Steps 3 and 4 identify critical imports with largest declines during 2008-2009 and 2019-2020 crises, but to better understand the onset of the COVID-19 crisis it is important to see import declines immediately before 2019.
steps.queried: imports · by HS2 product (top 10) · 2018–2019 · change between the two years
